title: Editable Welcome Book Template for Vacation Rental, Canva House Manual, Guest Guide, Short Term Rental Host, House Rules, Wifi, Checkout
description:
Give your guests a beautiful, professional welcome book and get fewer questions, smoother stays and better reviews. Edit everything in Canva in minutes, no design skills needed.

WHAT'S INCLUDED (12 pages)
- Cover with your property name and photo
- Contents
- A note from your host + contact
- Check-in & check-out
- Wi-Fi & essentials
- House rules
- How things work (TV, coffee machine, AC...)
- Emergency information
- Where to eat
- Things to do
- Check-out checklist
- Thank you & review page with QR code spot

YOU WILL RECEIVE
- A PDF with your Canva template link (free Canva account is enough)
- Print-ready PDF in US Letter (8.5 x 11 in) and A4

EASY TO CUSTOMIZE
Change all text, colors and fonts. Drag in your own photos. Add or remove pages. Download as PDF to print, or share the digital link with your guests.

PLEASE NOTE
- This is a DIGITAL product. No physical item will be shipped.
- Photos are not included; placeholders show where to add your own.
- For use in your own rental properties. Please do not resell or share the template.
- Designed with the help of AI tools, then reviewed and finalized by me.

Need help or a custom version? Send me a message, I usually reply within 24 hours.
